what: On first open, the name and greeting group rises at the center of the accent curtain (over a pale artwork background) from 50% below in 1s expo.inOut, swaps greetings one at a time every .15s (1.35s for nine), then moves up 75% while fading in .8s expo.in, and the whole curtain disappears in .6s power1.inOut. With no greeting to swap, the name stays up for the same time. Once fully cleared, it emits fx:done

options.words: Greetings to swap in (comma-separated), none by default — [data-fx-part=word] must exist for the text to change
options.count: number of words held when there are no words (each share), default 9 — the original Brand holds for 1.35s for 9 words with no slots (including one empty end)
options.overlap: Seconds to bring the curtain’s disappearance ahead of the exit end, default 0 — the original ”+ -0.2” is read by GSAP as a label and attaches to the end
options.y-out: Push up while dropping out (%), default −75
options.[data-fx-part=bg]: (optional) faint graphic over the veil — opacity --fx-bg-opacity (default .6)

use: Hello
note: Blocks the page until the curtain has fully lifted (the screen receives presses). If it opens often like an app, use data-fx-greeting-words-loader="in: .4; count: 0; out: .3; fade: .2"

from.where: index.html .ab-loader (original welcoming words — no words slot, only the name, 1s expo.inOut rise · .15s × 9 · .8s expo.in · .6s power1.inOut)
